dedupe_keys.name: atom geo ide application i2 port and maritime datasets

description: atom.geo-ide.application.i2: port and maritime datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.application.i2. Coverage: the area served by atom.geo-ide.application.i2. The listing groups 16 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Enjeux ponctuels du PPRN inondation par débordement direct du fleuve C; Renseignements existants et complémentaires ponctuels sur le PPRN inon; Capacité des ports de plaisance sur le littoral de la région Nouvelle ; PPRN inondation par débordement du fleuve Charente de la commune de Po. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
